name: fortinet-mantis-bug-fix-batch
display_name: Fortinet · Mantis Bug Fix (batch — ids OR filter)
description: Batch Fortinet Mantis bug-fix flow. Two ways to pick bugs: (A) comma-list of bug ids in `bug_ids`, OR (B) Mantis filter (keyword/source/status/assignee/reporter/project/query/fix_schedule/category/severity). When bug_ids is empty, a setup node calls mantis.search_bugs to discover ids, then for_each loops the full 10-node single-bug DAG (resolve → fix → MR → notify) per id. v0.5 adds the filter mode + tags MRs with forge:keyword::automation_test when the bug's Keywords contains 'QA Automation Test'.
author: forge
